svg.title: Decoder-only training is parallel; generation is sequential
svg.desc: A decoder-only Transformer uses a causal attention mask and next-token loss at every position. Teacher forcing computes those positions in parallel during training; sampling generates one token at a time and appends it to the prefix.

g.text: Decoder-only training is parallel; generation is sequential
A causal mask blocks future tokens, but every position can train in the same pass.
CAUSAL MASK · EACH POSITION SEES ONLY ITS PAST
Training: teacher forcing computes the next-token loss at every position in parallel.
The attention mask, not sequential execution, enforces autoregression.
GENERATION · SAMPLE AND APPEND ONE TOKEN AT A TIME
